The fix should be to check that `field` starts with `{` AND ends with `}` before stripping. If it doesn't end with `}`, we should raise an error.

- `{name` - missing closing brace
- `name}` - orphaned closing brace (this would go to the "else" branch in `_generate_expression`, not `_handle_field`)
- `{{name}` - escaped opening brace, then `name}` is plain text (this actually works correctly)
- `{name}}` - this might cause issues too

for part in PARSE_RE.split(self._format):
